pr_title: Only output type parameter constraint blank line if type parameter has a constraint
pr_body:
Blank lines are now only outputted for type constraints if they are required.

I expect the reason this has been missed before now is that the ``AssertEqual`` common method in the tests collapses whitespace, so the extra blank lines would not be compared.

I've added an ``AssertEqualPreserveLineBreaks`` method to preserve blank line characters.

New test has been added ``CSharpCodeGenerationTests.MethodTypeParameterConstraintLineOnlyAddedForTypesThatHaveConstraints``.

Fixes #31614

issue_context.title: System.CodeDom - Generic Method Adds 1 Blank Line per Type Parameter in Rendered Source
comments: @alistairjevans thanks for reporting. This is fairly low impact so it might be a while before it gets looked at. Any interest in debugging or offering a PR?
Yes, I can probably take a look; I'll post back here once I've got more info.

Just to update; I've tracked down the problem. In the method ``CSharpCodeGenerator.OutputTypeParameterConstraints``, for every type parameter in the method, a line is added to contain the type constraint for that parameter, even if there are no type constraints. 

So the fix is to only write that line if a constraint actually needs to be rendered.

I'll get a PR together.

review_comments: You're going to need to annotate these new tests as `[SkipOnTargetFramework(...)]` for .NET Framework, as it doesn't have the changes you're making.
